title: Change the details of a motor dealer, recycler or repairer premises
summary: Learn how to notify NSW Fair Trading of changes to the details of your motor dealer, recycler, or repairer premises.
intro:
If you hold a motor dealer, recycler or repairer licence and your notified premises or mobile workshop details have changed, you must notify NSW Fair Trading of a change to your details by email or at a Service NSW Centre:

This includes online motor dealers offering for sale and selling motor vehicles on their website.

'Notified premises' are premises (excluding trade shows) where you intend to carry on a business authorised by your licence including the URL address of an online motor dealer website.
who_can_apply: Hold a motor dealer, recycler, or repairer licence
Have changed notified premises or mobile workshop details
Operate an online motor dealer offering for sale and selling motor vehicles on their website
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Change to Notified Premises'
Details on where and when you will start or cease operating your business at the premises
Information on the intended use of your new premises or mobile workshop
Planning approval details for the business use of your premises

how_to_steps.text: Submit your completed form at a service centre, or email it to the address specified on the form.

more_info.text: To look up your licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: Who needs to notify NSW Fair Trading of a change?
faqs.a: Anyone who holds a motor dealer, recycler, or repairer licence and whose notified premises or mobile workshop details have changed.

faqs.q: What types of changes require notification?
faqs.a: Changes to your notified premises or mobile workshop details, including online motor dealers offering for sale and selling motor vehicles on their website.

faqs.q: How do I submit the change details?
faqs.a: You must notify NSW Fair Trading by email or at a Service NSW Centre.
